questions.text: If even numbers are blue and odd numbers are red, what colour is red + red?

questions.text: Jim is 6 ft 3 inches tall and when his friend Erica stands on a stool which is one foot tall, she becomes 2 inches taller than him. How tall is Erica? (Format: X feet Y inches)
questions.why: 6 ft 3 plus 2 inches = 6 ft 5, then take away one foot for the stool = 5 ft 5 inches.
